title: Tim Cook's parting message: Apple is in the hands of a product builder
description: Tim Cook handed the Apple CEO role to John Ternus, effective September 1, 2026, praising him as a product-first leader. The succession puts a hardware-and-engineering veteran in charge of Apple's AI strategy at a moment when Apple Intelligence and its broader roadmap are under intense scrutiny.

title: Apple shares 'shocking evidence' against former employee accused of stealing company data for OpenAI
description: Apple disclosed new evidence in its lawsuit against a former employee accused of taking confidential company data before joining OpenAI. The filing intensifies an ongoing legal dispute over trade-secret theft between two major AI players.

title: The Pentagon now has its own version of ChatGPT and Grok
description: The U.S. Department of Defense has deployed government-specific versions of OpenAI's ChatGPT and xAI's Grok for internal use. The move marks a significant step in federal government adoption of frontier AI models for sensitive and defense-related workflows.

title: Nvidia's $3.5B MediaTek bet reveals its plan for tackling Big Tech's AI chip buildout
description: Nvidia is investing $3.5 billion in MediaTek as part of a broader strategy to secure custom silicon supply for AI infrastructure buildouts. The deal illustrates how chipmakers are repositioning to meet the compute demands of frontier AI labs and hyperscalers.

title: Instagram puts new limits on undisclosed AI profiles
description: Meta's Instagram introduced new restrictions on AI-generated profiles that fail to disclose their synthetic nature. The policy aims to curb deceptive AI personas on the platform as AI-generated content becomes harder to distinguish from real accounts.

title: Clipto uses AI to search terabytes of video and is now valued at $250M
description: Clipto, a three-year-old startup that uses AI to make terabytes of video footage searchable, reached a $250 million valuation in its latest funding round. The company's growth reflects rising enterprise demand for AI-powered media search and indexing tools.

title: Improving our alignment and security efforts
description: Anthropic detailed new internal initiatives to strengthen model alignment and security practices across its research and deployment pipeline. The announcement reflects continued frontier-lab investment in safety infrastructure as models grow more capable and widely deployed.
